title: "Scaffolding"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_scaffolding               <- file.path(currentdir, "05_scaffolding")
outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref    <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, "01_union_to_ref")
outdir_scaffolding_haptounion    <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, "02_hap_to_union")
outdir_haptounion_virlike        <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding_haptounion, "virlike")
outdir_haptounion_declike        <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding_haptounion, "declike")
outdir_scaffolding_binning       <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, "03_binning")

sapply(c(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, outdir_haptounion_virlike, outdir_haptounion_declike, outdir_scaffolding_binning), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})

# check if scaffolding reference genome exists
if (!file.exists(params$scaffold_reference)) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Scaffolding reference genomes is not found. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}

# check if scaffolding metadata file exists
if (!file.exists(params$scaffold_chr_map)) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Scaffolding metadata file is not found. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

```{r ref-update}
# open the metadata file
df_scaffold_metadata <- data.table::fread(params$scaffold_chr_map)

# extract the respective chromosomes and update the names
seq <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(params$scaffold_reference)
seq <- seq[names(seq) %in% df_scaffold_metadata$old_id]
names(seq) <- sapply(names(seq), function(x) { df_scaffold_metadata$new_id[df_scaffold_metadata$old_id==x] })

# save the updated reference genome
fn_scaffold_ref <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$scaffold_reference)), ".fna"))
Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seq, filepath=fn_scaffold_ref)
```

```{r union-to-ref}
# combine the two haplotypes
fn_dedup_union <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, "union.dedup.fa")
system(paste("cat", fn_hap1_dedup, fn_hap2_dedup, ">", fn_dedup_union))

# run RagTag
fn_union2ref <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, "union_chr.fa")

if (!file.exists(fn_union2ref) || params$redo) {
    f_ragtag(fn_ref        = fn_scaffold_ref,
             fn_query      = fn_dedup_union,
             ragtag_params = "--mm2-params '-x asm20' -f 25000 -u -a 0.2",
             dir_out       = outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref,
             thread        = params$thread,
             exe_ragtag    = params$exe_ragtag)
    
    # extract the respective chromosomes
    system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "grep -r -p '^Chr'", file.path(outdir_scaffolding_uniontoref, "ragtag.scaffold.fasta"), "|",
                 params$exe_seqkit, "replace -p '_RagTag$' -r '' >", fn_union2ref))
}
```

```{r hap-to-union}
# open input files
df_assign  <- data.table::fread(file.path(outdir_assignment_final, "parent_of_contig.tsv"), sep="\t",
                                colClasses=list(character=c("contig", "partner")))
df_dvscore <- data.table::fread(file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, "dv_scoring.tsv"), sep="\t",
                                colClasses=list(character=c("contig", "partner")))

# iterate over parents
for (parent in c("decipiens", "virginea")) {
    # input files
    dir_parent <- ifelse(parent=="decipiens", outdir_haptounion_declike, outdir_haptounion_virlike)
    fn_asm     <- file.path(outdir_scaffolding, paste0(parent, "_like.fa"))
    if (!file.exists(paste0(fn_asm, ".fai"))) { 
        system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_asm))
    }

    # chromosome binning
    df_bins <- f_chromosome_bins(df_assign   = df_assign,
                                 df_dvscore  = df_dvscore,
                                 parent      = parent,
                                 col_chrom   = ifelse(parent=="decipiens", "dec_chrom", "vir_chrom"),
                                 min_aligned = 50)
    data.table::fwrite(df_bins, file.path(dir_parent, "chr_bins.tsv"), sep="\t")

    # set up variables
    ls_exclude  <- character(0)

    # iterative binning
    for (iter in seq_len(5)) {
        # create output directory
        dir_iter   <- file.path(dir_parent, sprintf("iter_%02d", iter))
        if (!dir.exists(dir_iter)) {
            dir.create(dir_iter, recursive=T)
        }

        # output files
        fn_exclude <- file.path(dir_iter, "excluded_contigs.txt")
        fn_beyond  <- file.path(dir_iter, "beyond_telomere.txt")

        # check if output file exists
        if (!file.exists(fn_beyond) || params$redo) {
            # write the exclusion list
            writeLines(ls_exclude, con=fn_exclude)

            # scaffold per chromosome
            ls_out <- f_scaffold_pass(df_bins       = df_bins,
                                      fn_asm        = fn_asm,
                                      fn_ref        = fn_union2ref,
                                      dir_iter      = dir_iter,
                                      ragtag_params = "--mm2-params '-x asm20' -f 25000 -u -a 0.2",
                                      fn_exclude    = if (length(ls_exclude) > 0) fn_exclude else NULL,
                                      thread        = params$thread,
                                      exe_seqkit    = params$exe_seqkit,
                                      exe_ragtag    = params$exe_ragtag)

            # look for telomeres
            fn_windows <- f_tidk_search(fn_fasta       = ls_out$fn_chromosomes,
                                        prefix         = parent,
                                        dir_out        = file.path(dir_iter, "tidk"),
                                        telomere_motif = "AAACCCT",
                                        exe_tidk       = params$exe_tidk)

            # check contigs outside of telomeres
            ls_telomere <- f_telomere_check(fn_windows     = fn_windows,
                                            fn_agp         = ls_out$fn_agp,
                                            fn_out         = file.path(dir_iter, "telomeres.tsv"),
                                            fn_ends_out    = file.path(dir_iter, "telomere_ends.tsv"),
                                            fn_exclude_out = fn_beyond,
                                            min_copies     = 100,
                                            min_anchor     = 10000000,
                                            edge           = 100000)
        }

        # extract fragments beyond a telomere that were not already excluded
        ls_beyond <- readLines(fn_beyond)
        ls_new    <- setdiff(ls_beyond, ls_exclude)

        # stop the loop if no new fragments found
        if (length(ls_new) == 0) {
            break
        }

        # update the excluded list
        ls_exclude <- union(ls_exclude, ls_new)
    }

    # update the log file if it has not converged
    if (length(ls_new) > 0) {
        log4r::warn(fn_logger, paste0(parent, ": not converged after 5 iterations."))
    }

    # save the output files
    writeLines(ls_exclude, file.path(dir_parent, "excluded_contigs.txt"))

    # save the final scaffolded sequence
    fn_final <- file.path(dir_parent, paste0("E_phylacis_", parent, "_like.scaffolds.fa"))
    system(paste("cat", file.path(dir_iter, "chromosomes.fa"), file.path(dir_iter, "unplaced.fa"), ">", fn_final))

    # copy the updated AGP file
    file.copy(file.path(dir_iter, "combined.agp"), file.path(dir_parent, paste0("E_phylacis_", parent, "_like.scaffolds.agp")), overwrite=T)

    # store the sequence statistics
    system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "stats", file.path(dir_iter, "chromosomes.fa"), file.path(dir_iter, "unplaced.fa"), fn_final, ">", file.path(dir_parent, "seqkit_stats.tsv")))
}
```
